premise: At the rock pool Lola starts a game: who has the most arms? She has two, Starfish five, and Octopus, wiggling every one, eight.
inspiration: The counting-rhyme contest (the folk 'who has more' game) made true: each friend wins a count, and the biggest number belongs to the octopus.
lesson: Everyone is made differently, and counting together is fun.
learning: An octopus has eight arms, and most starfish have five.

en-US.title: Who Has the Most Arms?
en-US.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola came to the edge of the rock pool and peeked in. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [curious] "Who's at home today?" {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to girl} Up came Octopus, orange and curly. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to octopus} Then Starfish, {starfish:face happy} smiling. {girl:says} [playfully] "Let's play a game. Who has the most arms?" {girl:live wave} Lola went first. One, two. Two arms! {starfish:live stretch} Starfish stretched out wide. One, two, three, four, five. {girl:face surprised} Five arms! [short pause] Then Octopus {octopus:live dance} wiggled all of his. {girl:says} [excited] "One, two, three, four, five, six, seven… EIGHT!" {octopus:face happy} Eight arms! Every octopus has eight. {girl:says} [laughs] "You win, Octopus!" [warmly] But two arms are just right for clapping, said Octopus. {girl:live clap} So Lola clapped, Starfish cheered, {octopus:live twirl} and Octopus twirled round and round, all eight arms swirling.

es-ES.title: ¿Quién tiene más brazos?
es-ES.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola se acercó a la charca de las rocas y miró dentro. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [curious] «¿Quién hay hoy en casa?» {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to girl} Salió Pulpo, naranja y rizado. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to octopus} Y luego Estrella, {starfish:face happy} muy sonriente. {girl:says} [playfully] «¡Vamos a jugar! ¿Quién tiene más brazos?» {girl:live wave} Empezó Lola. Uno, dos. ¡Dos brazos! {starfish:live stretch} Estrella se estiró bien. Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco. {girl:face surprised} ¡Cinco brazos! [short pause] Entonces Pulpo {octopus:live dance} meneó todos los suyos. {girl:says} [excited] «Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete… ¡OCHO!» {octopus:face happy} ¡Ocho brazos! Todos los pulpos tienen ocho. {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Has ganado, Pulpo!» [warmly] Pero dos brazos son perfectos para aplaudir, dijo Pulpo. {girl:live clap} Así que Lola aplaudió, Estrella lo celebró {octopus:live twirl} y Pulpo giró y giró, con sus ocho brazos al vuelo.

ja-JP.title: うでが いちばん おおいのは？
ja-JP.text: {girl:enter}{girl:go to pool}ローラが、潮だまりのふちにきて、のぞきこみました。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[curious]「きょうは、だれが、おうちにいるかな？」 {octopus:enter}{octopus:go to girl}ぬうっと出てきたのは、オレンジいろで、くるくるの、タコくん。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to octopus}それから、ヒトデさんも、{starfish:face happy}にっこり。{girl:says}[playfully]「ゲームしよう！うでがいちばんおおいのは、だーれだ？」 {girl:live wave}まずは、ローラ。いーち、にーい。二本！{starfish:live stretch}ヒトデさんは、ぐーんとのびました。いち、に、さん、し、ご。{girl:face surprised}五本！[short pause]それから、タコくんが、{octopus:live dance}うでをぜんぶ、くねくね。{girl:says}[excited]「いち、に、さん、し、ご、ろく、なな…はーち！」 {octopus:face happy}八本！タコは、みんな、うでが八本なのです。{girl:says}[laughs]「タコくんの、かち！」 [warmly]「でも、はくしゅするなら、二本がちょうどいいね」 とタコくん。{girl:live clap}ローラは、ぱちぱち。ヒトデさんは、ばんざい。{octopus:live twirl}タコくんは、八本のうでをひらひらさせて、くるりん、くるりん。

de-DE.title: Wer hat die meisten Arme?
de-DE.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola kam an den Rand des Tümpels und schaute hinein. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [curious] „Wer ist denn heute zu Hause?“ {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to girl} Da tauchte der Krake auf, orange und kringelig. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to octopus} Dann der Seestern, {starfish:face happy} mit einem Lächeln. {girl:says} [playfully] „Kommt, wir spielen ein Spiel. Wer hat die meisten Arme?“ {girl:live wave} Lola fing an. Eins, zwei. Zwei Arme! {starfish:live stretch} Der Seestern streckte sich ganz weit. Eins, zwei, drei, vier, fünf. {girl:face surprised} Fünf Arme! [short pause] Dann {octopus:live dance} wackelte der Krake mit allen seinen. {girl:says} [excited] „Eins, zwei, drei, vier, fünf, sechs, sieben… ACHT!“ {octopus:face happy} Acht Arme! Jeder Krake hat acht. {girl:says} [laughs] „Du hast gewonnen, Krake!“ [warmly] „Aber zwei Arme sind genau richtig zum Klatschen“, sagte der Krake. {girl:live clap} Also klatschte Lola, der Seestern jubelte, {octopus:live twirl} und der Krake drehte sich im Kreis, und alle acht Arme wirbelten mit.

fr-FR.title: Qui a le plus de bras ?
fr-FR.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola s’est approchée de la mare, et elle s’est penchée pour regarder. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [curious] « Qui est à la maison, aujourd’hui ? » {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to girl} Pieuvre est montée la première, toute orange, toute bouclée. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to octopus} Puis Étoile de mer, {starfish:face happy} avec un grand sourire. {girl:says} [playfully] « On fait un jeu ? Qui a le plus de bras ? » {girl:live wave} Lola a commencé. Un, deux. Deux bras ! {starfish:live stretch} Étoile s’est étirée bien grand. Un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq. {girl:face surprised} Cinq bras ! [short pause] Alors Pieuvre {octopus:live dance} a agité tous les siens. {girl:says} [excited] « Un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq, six, sept… HUIT ! » {octopus:face happy} Huit bras ! Toutes les pieuvres en ont huit. {girl:says} [laughs] « Tu as gagné, Pieuvre ! » [warmly] « Mais deux bras, c’est juste ce qu’il faut pour applaudir », a dit Pieuvre. {girl:live clap} Alors Lola a applaudi, Étoile a crié hourra, {octopus:live twirl} et Pieuvre a tourbillonné, tourné, tourné, avec ses huit bras qui virevoltaient.

it-IT.title: Chi ha più braccia?
it-IT.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola è arrivata sul bordo della pozza e ha guardato dentro. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [curious] «Chi c'è in casa, oggi?» {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to girl} Ed ecco salire Polpo, arancione e tutto arricciato. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to octopus} Poi Stella marina, {starfish:face happy} sorridente. {girl:says} [playfully] «Facciamo un gioco. Chi ha più braccia?» {girl:live wave} Ha cominciato Lola. Uno, due. Due braccia! {starfish:live stretch} Stella si è allungata ben bene. Uno, due, tre, quattro, cinque. {girl:face surprised} Cinque braccia! [short pause] Poi Polpo {octopus:live dance} ha agitato tutte le sue. {girl:says} [excited] «Uno, due, tre, quattro, cinque, sei, sette… OTTO!» {octopus:face happy} Otto braccia! Ogni polpo ne ha otto. {girl:says} [laughs] «Hai vinto tu, Polpo!» [warmly] «Però due braccia sono perfette per battere le mani», ha detto Polpo. {girl:live clap} Così Lola ha battuto le mani, Stella ha fatto evviva, {octopus:live twirl} e Polpo ha girato e girato, con tutte e otto le braccia che mulinavano.

zh-TW.title: 誰的手最多？
zh-TW.text: {girl:enter}{girl:go to pool}蘿拉走到潮池邊，探頭往裡面看。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[curious]「今天，誰在家呀？」 {octopus:enter}{octopus:go to girl}章魚冒出來了，橘橘的、捲捲的。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to octopus}接著是海星，{starfish:face happy}笑咪咪的。{girl:says}[playfully]「我們來玩遊戲。誰的手最多？」 {girl:live wave}蘿拉先來。一、二。兩隻手！{starfish:live stretch}海星把身體伸得開開的。一、二、三、四、五。{girl:face surprised}五隻手！[short pause]接著，章魚{octopus:live dance}把手全都扭來扭去。{girl:says}[excited]「一、二、三、四、五、六、七……八！」 {octopus:face happy}八隻手！每一隻章魚都有八隻手喔。{girl:says}[laughs]「章魚，你贏了！」 [warmly]「可是，兩隻手拍起手來剛剛好喔。」 章魚說。{girl:live clap}於是蘿拉啪啪啪地拍手，海星大聲歡呼，{octopus:live twirl}章魚轉呀轉、轉呀轉，八隻手一起飄呀飄。

zh-HK.title: 邊個最多手？
zh-HK.text: {girl:enter}{girl:go to pool}蘿拉走到石池邊，探頭往裏面看。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[curious]「今日有邊個喺屋企呀？」 {octopus:enter}{octopus:go to girl}八爪魚浮了上來，橙色的，手捲捲的。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to octopus}然後是海星，{starfish:face happy}笑眯眯的。{girl:says}[playfully]「我哋玩個遊戲！邊個嘅手最多？」 {girl:live wave}蘿拉先數。一、二。兩隻手！{starfish:live stretch}海星把身子伸得大大的。一、二、三、四、五。{girl:face surprised}五隻手！[short pause]然後，八爪魚{octopus:live dance}把所有的手都搖起來。{girl:says}[excited]「一、二、三、四、五、六、七……八！」 {octopus:face happy}八隻手！每一隻八爪魚，都有八隻手。{girl:says}[laughs]「八爪魚，你贏喇！」 [warmly]八爪魚說：「不過拍手呢，兩隻手就啱啱好。」 {girl:live clap}於是，蘿拉拍手，海星歡呼，{octopus:live twirl}八爪魚轉呀轉，八隻手一起轉圈圈。
